subject: Post-call: buy-cycle cadence and milestone card
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire O'Neill <claire.oneill@orchidhealth.com>, Devon Park <devon.park@orchidhealth.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwoodinference.com, marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + next steps (buy-cycle cadence & milestone card)

Thanks for the time today, Claire and Devon — good conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a shared cadence: 

Call highlights:
- Goal: 6-8 week POC to validate latency/cost with your anonymized sample and a Redwood-hosted staging endpoint.
- Decision criteria (as discussed): 1) predictable p99 latency under 250ms, 2) cost per 1k tokens within your target range, 3) security controls (VPC, logging, and incident response) satisfied.
- Economic buyer: you indicated Brian Keller (CFO) will sign off on spend.
- Security/procurement POCs: Devon (procurement) and Amrita Shah (security) — Devon please confirm Amrita's email if you'd like us to loop her in.

Proposed mutual action plan (MAP) headline milestones:
- Week 0: NDA + data handling checklist exchanged (we'll attach a starter security evidence pack).
- Week 1–2: Staging access + ingestion of sample dataset; baseline latency/cost run.
- Week 3: Security review + procurement checklist (evidence/doc handoff).
- Week 4–5: POC run and quality evals; customer review.
- Week 6: Decision review; executive sign-off or extension.

I've attached a one-tab milestone card (MAP_v1.xlsx) with owners and target dates — internal owners from our side: Soojin (eng contact), Marcus (legal/procurement enablement).

Asks from us to you this week:
1) Confirm final attendees and the economic approver (is Brian the sole sign-off?).
2) Share Amrita Shah's preferred contact for security evidence (SOC2 point contact).
3) Confirm procurement NDA path and expected timing for PO or standard SOW review.

I'll follow up with the MAP file and a calendar invite for a 30m check-in next Friday.

Thanks,
So
--
Soojin Lee
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0192

From: Claire O'Neill <claire.oneill@orchidhealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Devon Park <devon.park@orchidhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 11:02:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + next steps (buy-cycle cadence & milestone card)

Thanks Soojin — this is very helpful and in line with what we discussed. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Confirming Brian Keller (brian.keller@orchidhealth.com) is the economic approver. He wants a short exec summary + high-level cost delta versus current infra.
- Security lead is Amrita Shah (amrita.shah@orchidhealth.com); she'll own the evidence checklist. Her team will want SOC 2 Type II, data residency notes, and a brief on incident response SLAs.
- Procurement contact: Devon (copied) will lead NDA/SOW/PO. Our standard route is: legal redlines -> procurement review -> CFO sign-off. Typical internal timeline is 3 weeks for initial review if no major redlines.

We like the MAP cadence. Please add an explicit owner column for each milestone (we need to know which external person will sign off on each gate).

Two small asks: can you share a short security evidence stub we can hand to Amrita, and can Marcus review our procurement timeline once we share your SOW?

I'll get Devon to send Amrita's calendar availability and loop Brian into the next milestone review if the PO looks good.

On availability — I'll take the Friday check-in you suggested; 10:00–10:30 PT works for me.

Best,
Claire
--
Claire O'Neill
Head of AI Operations
Orchid Health
claire.oneill@orchidhealth.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire O'Neill <claire.oneill@orchidhealth.com>, Devon Park <devon.park@orchidhealth.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwoodinference.com, marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + next steps (MAP & evidence pack)

Great — thanks for the confirmations, Claire. Attaching the MAP_v1.xlsx (one-tab milestone card) and a short security evidence stub (security_evidence_request.pdf) for Amrita. Attachment notes: 
- MAP_v1.xlsx: milestone rows, suggested owners (we added an "external owner" column per your ask), and tentative target dates relative to kick-off.
- security_evidence_request.pdf: quick checklist (SOC2 status, data flow diagram, encryption at rest/in transit, logging/audit hooks) — Amrita should be able to use it to kickoff an internal gap review.

Marcus — can you please review the attached SOW stub in the MAP and highlight any items Orchid's procurement is likely to redline? We can pre-empt with commentary in the hubspot record (HS-00098234).

Devon/Claire — from our side we can commit to the Week 0 NDA and provide a staging endpoint within 5 business days after the NDA is returned.

I'll send the calendar invite for Fri 2028-03-24 10:00 PT and include Brian if he confirms availability.

Thanks,
So
--
Soojin Lee
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire O'Neill <claire.oneill@orchidhealth.com>, Devon Park <devon.park@orchidhealth.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, priyom_das@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Re: Post-call recap + next steps (procurement tips)

Claire/Devon — quick procurement heads-up from our legal/procurement side: 

1) Typical docs Orchid will request: NDA (mutual), Master Services Agreement (MSA) or SOW + Data Processing Addendum (DPA), and a standard PO for the POC fees if you require a purchase order.
2) Common redlines we see: indemnity caps, data residency/processing clauses, and specific audit windows. If you can flag which clauses matter to Brian (e.g., revenue threshold for caps), we can pre-populate suggested language to speed review.
3) Timeline: if Orchid's legal wants to redline, plan for 10 business days for a first review + back-and-forth. To keep to your 6-week decision target I'd suggest: a) get NDA+DPA approved quickly, b) accept POC SOW with standard POC pricing (we can invoice net-30) to remove blocker for technical evaluation.

I'll add a comment on HS-00098234 with suggested SOW text and a sample pricing hold (code SD-15 for internal tracking) — we can honor a POC pricing hold for 30 days after SOW sign.

If Orchid prefers, I can jump on a 15m call with your procurement to walk through the typical redlines and acceptable compromises.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Head of Legal Operations (enablement)
Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com

From: Claire O'Neill <claire.oneill@orchidhealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, Devon Park <devon.park@orchidhealth.com>
Date: Sat, 24 Mar 2028 15:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Re: Re: Post-call recap + next steps (confirming timeline)

Thanks all — appreciate the clarity. A few quick notes: 
- Devon will start the NDA route Monday morning. I'll introduce Amrita to the thread so she can review the evidence pack directly.
- I'll ask Brian for a 20m slot to join the Friday 10:00 PT check-in; if he can't make it we'll do the internal exec summary and loop him after he reviews the deliverable.
- The timeline looks good; Devon, can you confirm if Orchid will need a PO for the POC payment or if a signed SOW + invoice is acceptable?

I'll accept the calendar invite and will upload any procurement templates we use to the Drive link (please watch HS-00098234 for updates).

Best,
Claire
